next:or:108.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:108.hint: 問題そのものを主語にした書き換え
next:or:108.question: [[This problem is easy to be solved]].
next:or:108.answer: This problem is easy to solve
next:or:108.fullSentence: This problem is easy to solve.
next:or:108.wrongPart: This problem is easy to be solved
next:or:108.explanation: It is easy to solve this problem. → This problem is easy to solve. の書き換え(tough構文)。
next:or:108.relatedInfo: solveの目的語が主語に繰り上がるが、toの後は他動詞のままにする(×to be solved)。

next:or:109.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:109.hint: この薬は飲みやすい(快い)
next:or:109.fullSentence: This medicine is pleasant to take; it doesn't taste bad at all.
next:or:109.explanation: tough構文でよく使われる形容詞: easy(simple)⇔difficult(hard, tough, rough)、pleasant(comfortable)⇔unpleasant(uncomfortable)、safe⇔dangerous。
next:or:109.relatedInfo: 人の主観的な難易・快さを表す形容詞群。

next:or:110.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:110.hint: 程度が強すぎて出来ないことを表す構文
next:or:110.question: He is [[tired too to walk]] anymore.
next:or:110.fullSentence: He is too tired to walk anymore.
next:or:110.explanation: too ~ to do『とても〜なので…できない』。
next:or:110.relatedInfo: so ~ that S can't do とほぼ同義。

next:or:111.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:111.hint: 彼女は投票するのに十分な年齢だ
next:or:111.fullSentence: She is old enough to vote.
next:or:111.explanation: 形容詞/副詞+enough+to do『…するのに十分〜だ』。
next:or:111.relatedInfo: enoughは形容詞の後ろに置く点に注意。

next:or:112.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:112.question: He was smart [[not enough to solve]] the puzzle.
next:or:112.fullSentence: He was smart enough not to solve the puzzle.
next:or:112.explanation: 形容詞+enough not to do『〜しないほど…だ』。あえてしない賢明さを表す。
next:or:112.relatedInfo: He was not smart enough to solve the puzzle.(解けるほど賢くなかった)との違いに注意。

next:or:113.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:113.hint: 彼はパズルを解けるほど(十分)賢い
next:or:113.fullSentence: He is smart enough to solve the puzzle.
next:or:113.explanation: 形容詞+enough+to do『…するのに十分〜だ』の基本形。
next:or:113.relatedInfo: He was not smart enough to solve the puzzle.(否定形)との対比。

next:or:114.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:114.hint: 能力が足りなかったことを表す否定形
next:or:114.question: He [[was smart enough not to solve]] the puzzle.
next:or:114.answer: was not smart enough to solve
next:or:114.fullSentence: He was not smart enough to solve the puzzle.
next:or:114.wrongPart: was smart enough not to solve
next:or:114.explanation: not+形容詞+enough+to do『〜するほど…ではなかった』。
next:or:114.relatedInfo: smart enough not to solve(あえて解かないほど賢い)との違いに注意。

next:or:115.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:115.hint: 彼はパズルを解かないほど賢かった
next:or:115.fullSentence: He was smart enough not to solve the puzzle.
next:or:115.explanation: enough not to do『〜しないほど…だ』。
next:or:115.relatedInfo: notの位置に注意(enoughの後、toの前)。

next:or:116.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:116.hint: 賢さも足りず、あえて解かないという選択もできなかったニュアンス
next:or:116.question: He was [[not smart enough to solve]] the puzzle.
next:or:116.answer: not smart enough not to solve
next:or:116.fullSentence: He was not smart enough not to solve the puzzle.
next:or:116.explanation: not+形容詞+enough not to do『〜しないほど…ではなかった(結局〜してしまった)』。
next:or:116.relatedInfo: 否定が二重に重なる複雑な構文。

next:or:117.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:117.hint: 彼は成功するほど一生懸命働いた
next:or:117.fullSentence: He worked hard so as to succeed.
next:or:117.explanation: so ~ as to do『〜するほど…だ、とても…なので〜する』。
next:or:117.relatedInfo: so as to do は「〜するために」の意味でも使われる(目的)。

next:or:118.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:118.hint: enoughを使った丁寧な依頼表現
next:or:118.question: Would you be [[enough kind to direct]] me to the library?
next:or:118.fullSentence: Would you be kind enough to direct me to the library?
next:or:118.explanation: Would you be kind enough to do?『〜していただけますか』丁寧な依頼表現。
next:or:118.relatedInfo: Would you be so kind as to do? とも言う。

next:or:119.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:119.hint: 彼は試験に合格するために一生懸命勉強した(目的)
next:or:119.fullSentence: He studied hard so as to pass the exam.
next:or:119.explanation: so as to do ＝ in order to do『〜するために(目的)』。
next:or:119.relatedInfo: 否定形はso as not to doとなる。

next:or:120.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:120.hint: 悪い状況が重なることを表す慣用句
next:or:120.question: [[To make it worse]], it started to rain.
next:or:120.fullSentence: To make matters worse, it started to rain.
next:or:120.explanation: to make matters worse『さらに悪いことに』。独立不定詞の慣用表現。
next:or:120.relatedInfo: 文頭に置いて後続の悪い出来事を導く。

next:or:121.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:121.hint: 実を言うと、私は彼が好きではない
next:or:121.fullSentence: To tell you the truth, I don't like him.
next:or:121.explanation: to tell (you) the truth『実を言うと』。独立不定詞の慣用表現。
next:or:121.relatedInfo: 文頭で本音を切り出すときに使う。

next:or:122.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:122.hint: 認めつつも続きがあることを予感させる表現
next:or:122.question: [[To be sure of]], he is talented, but he lacks experience.
next:or:122.fullSentence: To be sure, he is talented, but he lacks experience.
next:or:122.explanation: to be sure『確かに』。独立不定詞の慣用表現。しばしばbutを伴い譲歩を表す。
next:or:122.relatedInfo: of courseに近いニュアンス。

next:or:123.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:123.hint: まず第一に、自己紹介をしましょう
next:or:123.fullSentence: To begin with, let's introduce ourselves.
next:or:123.explanation: to begin (start) with『まず第一に、手始めに』。独立不定詞の慣用表現。
next:or:123.relatedInfo: 文頭に置いて話の順序を示す。

next:or:124.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:124.hint: 遠慮せず本音を述べることを示す表現
next:or:124.question: [[To frank with you]], I think your plan is flawed.
next:or:124.fullSentence: To be frank with you, I think your plan is flawed.
next:or:124.explanation: to be frank with you『率直に言うと』。独立不定詞の慣用表現。
next:or:124.relatedInfo: frankly speaking(分詞構文)とほぼ同義。

next:or:125.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:125.hint: 彼を公平に判断すれば、彼は勤勉な人だ
next:or:125.fullSentence: To do him justice, he is a hard worker.
next:or:125.explanation: to do A justice『Aを公平に判断すれば』。独立不定詞の慣用表現。
next:or:125.relatedInfo: 欠点を挙げた後にフォローする文脈でよく使う。

next:or:126.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:126.hint: 勇気があることを表す名詞+to do
next:or:126.question: She has [[the courage speaking]] her mind.
next:or:126.fullSentence: She has the courage to speak her mind.
next:or:126.explanation: have the courage to do『〜する勇気がある』。
next:or:126.relatedInfo: 名詞the courage+to不定詞の形容詞的用法。

next:or:127.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:127.hint: 彼は母語は言うまでもなく、3つの言語を話す
next:or:127.fullSentence: He speaks three languages, to say nothing of his native one.
next:or:127.explanation: to say nothing of A『Aは言うまでもなく』。独立不定詞の慣用表現。
next:or:127.relatedInfo: not to mention Aともほぼ同義。

next:or:128.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:128.hint: 実際はもっと強い評価であることを示唆する表現
next:or:128.question: His behavior was rude, [[to say least of it]].
next:or:128.answer: to say the least of it
next:or:128.fullSentence: His behavior was rude, to say the least of it.
next:or:128.explanation: to say the least (of it)『控えめに言っても』。独立不定詞の慣用表現。
next:or:128.relatedInfo: 実際はもっと強い表現が当てはまることを暗示する。

next:or:129.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:129.hint: 言うまでもなく、彼はその結果に失望した
next:or:129.fullSentence: Needless to say, he was disappointed with the result.
next:or:129.explanation: needless to say, ~『言うまでもなく〜だ』。独立不定詞の慣用表現。
next:or:129.relatedInfo: 文頭に置くのが一般的。

next:or:130.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:130.hint: 最上級の評価は避けつつ高評価を示す表現
next:or:130.question: He is very clever, [[not to say genius is]].
next:or:130.fullSentence: He is very clever, not to say a genius.
next:or:130.explanation: not to say A『Aとは言わないまでも』。独立不定詞の慣用表現。
next:or:130.relatedInfo: 控えめな評価をしつつ、より強い可能性を示唆する。

next:or:131.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:131.hint: 奇妙な話だが、その見知らぬ2人は兄弟だとわかった
next:or:131.fullSentence: Strange to say, the two strangers turned out to be brothers.
next:or:131.explanation: strange to say『奇妙な話だが』。独立不定詞の慣用表現。
next:or:131.relatedInfo: 文頭に置いて意外な事実を導入する。

next:or:132.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:132.hint: それだけで十分だと強調する構文
next:or:132.question: [[All you have do is]] press this button.
next:or:132.answer: All you have to do is
next:or:132.fullSentence: All you have to do is press this button.
next:or:132.explanation: All S have to do is (to) do ~『Sは〜さえすればよい』。
next:or:132.relatedInfo: isの後のtoは省略されることが多い。
